expectText: What percentage of claim denials are considered preventable according to MGMA data?

set.text: According to Change Healthcare's 2020 Denials Index, what share of claim denials are potentially avoidable?
set.explanation: Change Healthcare's 2020 Denials Index found that 86% of denials are potentially avoidable through better registration and eligibility checks, authorization tracking, documentation, coding, and pre-submission edits.

src: Change Healthcare 2020 Revenue Cycle Denials Index (Becker's, search 2026-10-09): 86% of denials potentially avoidable; Change Healthcare Healthy Hospital Revenue Cycle Index (2016 data): ~3.3% of net patient revenue put at risk by denials. No MGMA source for 67% preventable; no source for 9% net revenue lost
